df5b29b549659.title: Check link (detailed)
df5b29b549659.description: Check if an HTTP or HTTPS URL returns an acceptable status code from a GET request.

dc61fce3f9f25.description: URL to check. Can be a full URL or a path. If a path is provided, `origin` must be specified.

d44bde413aec6.description: Query parameters to append to the resolved URL. Merged on top of `originParams` from config; step keys win on collision. If `url` already contains a colliding query key, the value here replaces it. Values support environment variable substitution via `$VAR` syntax. WARNING: values are embedded in the request URL and appear in test results, logs, and reports.

d723a44d0e9a0.description: Accepted status codes. If the specified URL returns a code other than what is specified here, the action fails.

de910d694cf55.title: Request headers (object)
de910d694cf55.description: Headers to include in the HTTP request, in key/value format. Values must be strings.

d8a57c715f527.title: Request headers (string)
d8a57c715f527.description:
Headers to include in the HTTP request, as newline-separated values. For example, `X-Api-Key: abc123
Authorization: Bearer token`.

d95014b86ae45.description: Additional HTTP headers to include in the request. Merged on top of Doc Detective's default browser-mimicking headers. Useful for sites behind bot protection or WAFs that allowlist specific headers (for example, a Cloudflare Access service token or a `Cookie` with a `cf_clearance` value).

origin.description: Protocol and domain to navigate to. Prepended to `url`.
